problem_type: GPU owner releases resources before asynchronous consumers finish
symptom: The complete desktop output journey reports unhandled No target despite successful PNG/MP4 output; removing the visible director's SparkHost during readPause deterministically reproduces the error.
direct_cause: SparkHost calls dispose during Spark2.1 driveSort's readPause await; accumulator targets are cleared before readbackDepth resumes. Queued update/sort timers and LoD work also outlive synchronous disposal.
class_root: Host retirement does not stop admission and drain asynchronous readers before releasing their owned GPU resources.
affected_population: Idle, sorting and LoD-active Spark hosts

external_sources.purpose: SparkRenderer owns GPU resources and performs asynchronous sorting; update and dispose are distinct operations.
Current upstream dispose still releases accumulators synchronously; driveSort awaits readPause and signals onDirty after sorting=false.
SplatWorker.exclusive provides an ordered queue barrier for outstanding LoD work.

invariants: Detached renderers admit no new automatic update, sort or LoD work.
Targets remain alive until active sorting and LoD work finish.
Idle and repeated retirement complete exactly once without waiting for a nonexistent signal.
generality_proof: All src SparkRenderer construction and disposal converge at SparkHost. The retirement helper fences all public scheduling channels and drains existing consumers for every host, without object/vendor-specific branches.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Stop admission, await actual resource readers, then release the renderer once.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The visible viewport and PiP share this sole scene-root SparkRenderer and its retirement helper.
Inspected the separate FencedCanvas: it mounts SkyGround/PanoramaSphere/DirectorEntities but no SparkHost, and does not construct or dispose SparkRenderer.
Owns SplatMesh and reveal; it does not dispose the SparkRenderer accumulator targets consumed by driveSort.

recurrence.reason: Any host removal can intersect readPause, sorting, delayed scheduling or LoD work.
same_class_scan: rg new SparkRenderer and spark.dispose across src found only SparkHost.
Inspected DirectorCanvas, visible/PiP and headless output consumers, SplatEntity ownership, Spark2.1 dispose/updateInternal/driveSort/readbackDepth and SplatWorker.exclusive.

prevention.invariant: No owned GPU target is released while its asynchronous reader is live.
prevention.failure_mode: Active operation errors remain observable; no catch swallows decoder/render failures or disguises them as successful disposal.
prevention.strategy: Use public scheduling fields, sort completion notification and the LoD worker queue barrier; memoize one retirement promise per renderer.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the direct synchronous dispose-on-unmount path; every host uses the shared retirement boundary.

dependency_lifecycle.target: A supported Spark release with an awaitable disposal/cancellation contract covering sorting, queued updates and LoD workers
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Installed and latest upstream source retain the same synchronous dispose race. The adapter preserves native frame scheduling and uses typed public lifecycle state, rather than copying the sorter or disabling capabilities.
exit_criteria: Upstream awaitable disposal stops queued updates/sorts and drains sorting/LoD without late resource access.
Replace retireSparkRenderer with the upstream API and pass the real-Spark readPause/idle/LoD/repeated-host slice plus Electron PNG/MP4 and SPZ journeys.

migration: No project-data changes; active renderers gain safe retirement at the sole host cleanup boundary.
residual_risks: An independently failing upstream sort that never reaches its completion notification remains an observable renderer failure, not a fabricated successful drain; the GPU resources are not freed beneath that failed consumer.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/scene/environment/retireSparkRenderer.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
